summary: The implementation at HEAD 4d41b8b matches confirmed requirement R-1 by code inspection: preview() now truncates to PREVIEW_LIMIT=8, and receipt_reference() still truncates to DISPLAY_LIMIT=12, the same as the base. The intermediate commit 1fb70a0 had set the shared DISPLAY_LIMIT to 8, which would have shortened receipts too. HEAD reverses that, so the net diff from the base leaves receipt behavior unchanged. I found no implementation mismatch. Delivery is still not supported: the source image layout.png is listed in the index but missing, the feature status is 'provisional', there is no actual test-run evidence (the only quality report is a synthetic compile claim), the traceability test IDs are not tied to real test functions, and no verification.json or delivery report exists. These are evidence gaps, not code defects. Verdict: the implementation looks right, but delivery evidence is incomplete, so the feature stays provisional.
